texts.label: text
texts.orig: Background subtraction. A fixed background subtraction method is applied to isolate the plume; where the first L_subtraction frames of video (where no plumes are have formed) are used to create an average background image. The average image is subtracted against the remaining frames to create the isolated plume frames. Once the plume dynamics have been isolated from background across selected frames; Gaussian blurring is kfixed applied.

texts.orig: Gaussian Blurring. Two separately tuned Gaussian filters are temporal  and spatial filter, respecitvely. Second, a Gaussian filter is applied to each frame independently to coarse grain the image; adding spatial blur. applied
